# Check configured regular expressions as executable behavior

671 adds the comm-bump-esr128 base regex with an unclosed group. The focused 24712234b3a follow-up changes it to a closed alternation, and the later reland includes that correction. The transform compiles both configured patterns before looking at tag data, so a malformed pattern blocks the task. Proposed manual YAML rule: quotes preserve regex backslashes but do not make the expression valid; check the formatted branch-specific expression and grouping separately. Only the focused public follow-up diff was read; its review and a transform run remain pending.

Scope: Merge automation YAML regex syntax.
